metadata.title: We make experiences | VR & Mixed Reality
metadata.description: Discover games, mixed reality experiences and creative experiments from FoVR Interactive, an immersive experience studio based in Brisbane, Australia.

experiences.title: Immersive learning
experiences.description: Experiences that invite you to explore, experiment and learn by doing.

experiences.title: Mixed reality
experiences.description: Passthrough, hand tracking and spatial interfaces that combine digital content with real environments.

experiences.title: VR games & experiences
experiences.description: Interactive worlds to step into, play with and make your own.

experiences.title: Creative experiments
experiences.description: New ideas in XR, AI and spatial interaction, explored through hands-on prototypes.

delivery.title: Start with curiosity
delivery.description: Find an idea worth exploring and imagine how it could feel to experience it.

delivery.title: Prototype on hardware
delivery.description: Validate important interactions early on the device people will actually use.

delivery.title: Build for production
delivery.description: Develop with performance, comfort, usability and deployment constraints in mind.

delivery.title: Iterate with evidence
delivery.description: Test, learn and refine the experience around real use rather than assumptions.

text.games_worlds_and_interactions_that_invit: Games, worlds and interactions that invite you to step in and explore. FoVR Interactive is a creative studio making virtual reality, mixed reality and interactive experiences, from playful experiments to releases you can enjoy.
text.we_bring_together_realtime_3d_interactio: We bring together real-time 3D, interaction design and a curiosity for what comes next. The goal is simple: make something that feels good to interact with and gives you a reason to explore.
text.explore_our_releases_and_see_what: Explore our releases and see what we are bringing to life next.
text.from_an_idea_to_a_world: From an idea to a world you can step into.
text.we_explore_an_idea_try_it: We explore an idea, try it on real hardware and keep refining. Comfort, performance and the feel of each interaction matter as much as how it looks.
text.research_and_prototyping_for_what_comes: Research and prototyping for what comes next.
text.labs_is_our_space_to_experiment: Labs is our space to experiment with mixed reality, hand tracking, AI-assisted experiences, WebXR and spatial interfaces. Some ideas will grow into future releases. Others are here to explore what is possible.
text.have_a_question_about_an_experience: Have a question about an experience?
text.we_welcome_player_feedback_support_quest: We welcome player feedback, support questions and conversations about what we are making.
